body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2011') -- <Visual News> Coby(www.coby.com) introduced 7-inch Android Tablet PC 'KYROS MID7025' at the International Consumer Electronics Show(CES) held at Las Vegas, USA, for 4 days from January 6.
MID7025 is loaded 7-inch touch screen. It features Cortex A8 1GHz processor, 4GB internal memory and Wi-Fi with Android 2.1 platform.
<AVING Special Report Team for 2011 International CES: Ideak Kim, Kevin Choi, Joseph Choi, Paul Shin, Jun Lim, Daniel Kim, Ashley Kim, Sohpia Kwag, Mia Eun, Sena Moon, Jiny Kim, Astin Jung>
